result.instructions: Tools for Prisync, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our products are cheaper than the competitor prices right now?"; "Show me the SmartPrice suggestions for our products."; "List the products in our account that have no barcode.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Prisync data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run prisync_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run prisync_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run prisync_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. prisync_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: prisync_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Return the Prisync account details, including the product package limit. Good first call to check the connection. Prisync API: GET /account/.

tools.name: prisync_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products in the account (name, brand, category, product code, barcode, cost, tags), 100 a page. Use nextURL to get the next page. Prisync API: GET /list/product/startFrom/{startFrom}.

startFrom.description: Offset of the first item: 0 for the first page, then 100, 200, and so on (each page holds up to 100 items).

tools.name: prisync_list_products_with_prices
tools.title: List products with prices
tools.description: List the products with their price summary (competitor prices and our position), 100 a page. Use nextURL to get the next page. Prisync API: GET /list/product/summary/startFrom/{startFrom}.

startFrom.description: Offset of the first item: 0 for the first page, then 100, 200, and so on (each page holds up to 100 items).

tools.name: prisync_list_smartprices
tools.title: List SmartPrice suggestions
tools.description: List the SmartPrice suggestions generated for the products (product id, product code, barcode, suggested price, our position), 100 a page. Prisync API: GET /list/smartprice/startFrom/{startFrom}.

startFrom.description: Offset of the first item: 0 for the first page, then 100, 200, and so on (each page holds up to 100 items).

tools.name: prisync_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id: name, brand, category, product code, barcode, cost and tags. Prisync API: GET /get/product/id/{id}.

tools.name: prisync_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List the brands in the store, 100 a page. Prisync API: GET /list/brand/startFrom/{startFrom}.

startFrom.description: Offset of the first item: 0 for the first page, then 100, 200, and so on (each page holds up to 100 items).

tools.name: prisync_get_brand
tools.title: Get a brand
tools.description: Get one brand by id. Prisync API: GET /get/brand/id/{id}.

tools.name: prisync_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the categories in the store, 100 a page. Prisync API: GET /list/category/startFrom/{startFrom}.

startFrom.description: Offset of the first item: 0 for the first page, then 100, 200, and so on (each page holds up to 100 items).

tools.name: prisync_get_category
tools.title: Get a category
tools.description: Get one category by id. Prisync API: GET /get/category/id/{id}.

tools.name: prisync_get_url
tools.title: Get a competitor URL
tools.description: Get one tracked competitor URL by id. Prisync API: GET /get/url/id/{id}.

tools.name: prisync_add_product
tools.title: Add a product
tools.description: Create a product in the account. Name, brand and category are required. Creates a record that counts toward the package limit. Prisync API: POST /add/product.

tools.name: prisync_add_url
tools.title: Add a competitor URL
tools.description: Track a competitor URL for an existing product, so Prisync starts collecting its price. Prisync API: POST /add/url.

product_id.description: Id of the product to track the URL for (from prisync_list_products).

tools.name: prisync_edit_product
tools.title: Edit a product
tools.description: Change the fields of one product. Only the fields you pass change. Tags, when passed, replace the old tags. Prisync API: POST /edit/product/id/{id}.

tags.description: New comma-separated tags; replaces the old tags.
